memories.title: Static site redesign pattern: CSS custom properties design system
memories.text: When rebuilding a legacy Angular/Bootstrap app as a static vanilla HTML/CSS/JS site, use CSS custom properties as the entire design system (no framework needed). Define tokens for: colors (primary, surface, text, border, status), typography (font-family, sizes xs-5xl, weights, line-heights), spacing (--space-1 through --space-24), shadows (xs-xl), radii, and transitions. Components styled as BEM-like selectors referencing these tokens. This approach gives full control with zero dependencies and works by opening index.html directly.

mem-2.intent: Replacing a complex framework app with a maintainable, token-driven pure CSS design system
mem-2.experience: Built MeetRoom redesign — design system with 50+ tokens across 600 lines of component CSS. CSS balanced (249/249 braces). No build step, no npm, works by opening index.html.
